title: Peruvian Causa Rellena de Papa
description: A traditional Peruvian dish consisting of stuffed potatoes with various fillings, typically served as a main course or light lunch.
instructions: 2. Bake the limena potatoes for 45-50 minutes, or until they're tender.
3. Scoop out the potato flesh and mash in a bowl.
4. Add the causa, red onion, garlic, cilantro, and ají amarillo pepper to the bowl. Mix well.
5. Season the mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
6. Stuff each potato shell with the mixture.
7. Serve the causa rellena garnished with additional cilantro, if desired.
